name: bcrypthash
description: Generates a salted bcrypt hash of a string. Each call produces a different hash (a random salt is embedded), and the cost factor is encoded in the result. Returns the $2a$ variant so hashes are interchangeable with the org.mindrot.jbcrypt.BCrypt shim and reference engines. This is the Lucee crypto-extension name; the modern RustCFML name is bcryptHash() and the deprecated form is generateBCryptHash(). Available when the security cargo feature is enabled.

params.name: cost
params.description: The bcrypt work factor, between 4 and 31 (default 10).

examples.title: Hash a password
examples.description: Hash with the default cost of 10.
examples.code:
hash = bcrypthash("secret");
writeDump(bcrypthash("secret") == hash); // false - random salt each call

examples.title: Verify the hash
examples.description: Check a password against a stored bcrypt hash.
